div.div: 7 انصلعت الشَّمْسُ (tropical:) The sun rose, or began to rise: syn. بَزَغَت: or culminated: or came forth from the clouds, (O, K, TA,) appearing in the time of intense heat, with nothing intervening and concealing it; (TA;) and so ↓ تِصلّعت , (O, K, TA,) and ↓ صَلَعَت [or more probably صَلِعَت]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
